description: Land Acquisition - Ethgala, Ganga Ihala Korale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels to be acquired for public purpose. It contains descriptions of land lots, claimants, and extents, along with procedures for compensation claims. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition and property matters, not government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
